# MiniMax consumer fixture

The six MM05-design-load cases were copied byte-for-byte from the retained successful ordinary bundle `.evidence/minimax-current-eleven-gate-2/gate/offline/20261019T064845.243220000Z/manifest.json`, whose artifact hashes were checked before copying. The JSONL gzip contains a projected manifest and base64-encoded original artifact files. It is an offline consumer fixture, not current capacity, race or vendor qualification. No new load was generated to create it.

Keep this fixture until the MiniMax artifact contract changes; then explicitly capture a newly authorized load and update this provenance. Ordinary consumer tests must never generate the load themselves. Different native consumer contracts keep their own fixtures and evolve independently.
